lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill region; a group of four prominent blobs forms a trapezoidal pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like topology across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are distributed across the first dorsal fin silhouette with a higher spatial frequency observed along the leading edge compared to the trailing margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A minor irregular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin; a distinct elongated high-luminance attachment is present at the ventral base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the snout; high-contrast vertical lineation defining five gill slits.
